title: 第650章 力压屈屠第659章 接圣墟一招
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
秦浩说罢全场瞬间死寂。
所有人都愣住了，怀疑自己听错了。
他竟然答应了？
“他疯了？”
“圣墟境全力一击，他一个血沸境拿什么扛？”
“这可不是之前的压制状态！屈屠现在圣墟恢复了！”
“活该！这秦皓有点实力便如此狂妄自大，绝对死定了。”
外围的探子们都傻了眼，本以为有兰厉出头，秦皓顺坡下驴便可避开死局，没想到他竟真的应了下来。
屈祁修也愣了一下，随即嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度。
好，很好！既然自己找死，那就怨不得别人了。
同时，屈屠也呲着牙扯出一个狰狞的笑。
圣墟境的法则之力在他周身翻涌，他盯着秦皓，像是在盯一个已经死了的人，终于能亲手捏死这只蝼蚁了！
“既然赶着找死，老夫今日便成全你。”
话音未落，天空中一声暴喝炸响。
“屈祁修！你他娘的敢动我学生！”
那声音从极高极远的天际尽头传来，像一道旱地惊雷从天穹顶上滚过，震得在场所有人的耳膜嗡嗡作响。
人未至，势先到。
一股恐怖的压力从天而降，整片后山废墟上的碎石都在微微震颤，像是有什么极其沉重的东西正在以不可思议的速度砸下来。
众人下意识抬头。
一个黑点出现在天幕上，急剧放大，像一颗陨石般从云层中直直砸落，身后拖着一道土黄色的尾迹，直直砸向场中的屈屠。

屈屠的狞笑僵在了脸上，瞳孔骤然收缩，心底骤然升起死亡的寒意。
他来不及想是谁，周身数十丈内燃起冲天烈焰，唤出法象真身。
“犀皇碎山！”
他怒吼一声，将全身圣墟之力尽数灌进法象真身，迎着那道黑影狠狠轰上去。
赤色拳影与黑影撞在一起。
那道人影却没有出招，只是砸了下来。
纯粹的力，蛮横到极致的力，那人影砸落的瞬间，焚宇犀皇的虚影发出一声哀鸣，庞大的身躯在那一肘的余力下寸寸崩裂，整个法象真身像一面被击碎的琉璃屏风般炸开。
屈屠仰天喷出一口血箭，连惨叫都没发出来，整个人像颗钉子，被硬生生砸进脚下的地面里。
地面炸开一个直径数十丈的深坑，周围的碎石被气浪掀飞。
全场死寂。
一尊圣墟境，就这么被人从天上砸下来，一拳打进了地里？
烟尘缓缓散去，坑边立着一道壮硕的身影。
那人身高近丈，肩宽背厚，一头乱糟糟的黑发随意披散在肩上，背上背着一只一人高的朱红酒葫芦，络腮胡子乱糟糟的，眼神却亮得像火把。
秦皓眼前一亮，脱口而出：“老师！”
content_en:
After Qin Hao said this, the whole place fell silent for an instant.
Everyone was stunned, suspecting that they heard wrongly.
He actually agreed?
"Is he crazy?"
"With a full-strength attack from the Saint Ruins Realm, what can he do with a Blood Boiling Realm person?"
"This is not the previous suppressed state! Qu Tu has restored the Holy Ruins now!"
"You deserve it! This Qin Hao is so arrogant and arrogant even though he has some strength. He is definitely dead."
The spies on the periphery were all dumbfounded. They thought that with Lan Li stepping forward, Qin Hao could avoid death by getting off the donkey, but they didn't expect that he actually agreed.
Qu Qixiu was also stunned for a moment, and then the corners of his mouth curved into a cold arc.
OK, very good! Since you are seeking death, you can't blame others.
At the same time, Qu Tu bared his teeth and made a ferocious smile.
The power of the laws of the Saint Ruins Realm surged around him. He stared at Qin Hao as if he were staring at a dead person. He was finally able to crush the ant with his own hands!
"Since you are looking for death, I will help you today."
Before he finished speaking, there was a loud roar and explosion in the sky.
"Qu Qixiu! How dare you touch my student!"
The sound came from extremely high and far away from the end of the sky, like a dry land thunder rolling across the sky dome, making the eardrums of everyone present buzz.
The force arrives first before the people arrive.
A terrifying pressure fell from the sky, and the entire rubble on the ruins of the back mountain trembled slightly, as if something extremely heavy was falling down at an incredible speed.
Everyone looked up subconsciously.
A black spot appeared on the sky, magnified sharply, and fell straight from the clouds like a meteorite, trailing an earthy yellow trail behind it and hitting Qu Tu in the field.
Qu Tu's ferocious smile froze on his face, his pupils suddenly shrank, and the chill of death suddenly rose in his heart.
He didn't have time to think about who it was. Flames burst into the sky within dozens of feet around him, summoning the true form of the Dharma Elephant.
"The Rhinoceros Emperor Shatters the Mountain!"
He roared angrily, poured all the power of the Holy Ruins into the Dharma Elephant's true body, and blasted towards the black shadow.
The red fist shadow collided with the black shadow.
The figure didn't make any move, but just smashed it down.
Pure power, arrogant power to the extreme, the moment the figure fell, the shadow of Fenyu Rhinoceros let out a cry, and the huge body shattered inch by inch under the remaining force of the elbow, and the entire Dharma Elephant's true body exploded like a shattered glass screen.
Qu Tu looked up to the sky and spat out a blood arrow, without even letting out a scream. His whole body was like a nail, being smashed into the ground beneath his feet.
A deep pit with a diameter of dozens of feet exploded on the ground, and the surrounding debris was blown away by the air waves.
The whole place was dead silent.
A Saint Ruins Realm was smashed down from the sky and punched into the ground?
The smoke slowly dissipated, and a strong figure stood beside the pit.
The man was nearly ten feet tall, with broad shoulders and a thick back. His messy black hair was casually spread over his shoulders. He carried a scarlet wine gourd as tall as a person on his back. He had messy beard, but his eyes were as bright as torches.
Qin Hao's eyes lit up and he blurted out: "Teacher!"
